logic-lagoon-help-v2: Tap a square, then a picture or number. Every row and column needs one of each. Boxes and cage totals add clues. Notes keep possible numbers. Undo takes back an edit. A hint teaches one step. In Challenge, fill the whole grid and press Check when you are ready.
logic-lagoon-step-up: If Level 3 feels easy, Level 4 is open. Find the only place for a number on a bigger grid. Level 5 adds cages. Challenge has cages without starting numbers and grids with only arrows. Every level stays open.
